summary: Contestants develop a creative theme, design a logo, and create a promotional flyer to advertise their school or district's STEM Night & Innovation Showcase. All graphics must be original and computer generated, and contestants present their work to judges. Entries must follow strict submission guidelines and are evaluated on creativity, effectiveness, and presentation skills.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than five (5) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at five (5) minutes
submission_requirements: All items saved as PDFs and bundled together in one PDF file
Contestant ID required for all submissions
No changes can be made to the project after the date of submission
Materials must follow BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual
Signed BPA Release Form(s) required for any person whose image or work is used
AI Usage and Documentation Form required
deadlines: Submit to https://upload.bpa.org no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on April 1, 2027
what_to_bring: One single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for presentation
competencies: Apply graphic design principles & elements including layout and typography to create a design aligned with brand
Use color theory, visual hierarchy, image editing and illustration techniques to create cohesive, theme-based designs
Prepare marketing materials optimized for print and digital platforms, ensuring color accuracy, resolution standards, and cross-platform compatibility
Develop and present concepts and artwork using industry-standard tools and platforms

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

The following items have been saved as PDFs and bundled together in one PDF file. 1. Logo 2. Flyer 3. Works Cited (formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual) 4. BPA Release Form(s) 5. AI Usage and Documentation Form

rubric.description: Strong, clear promotion of STEM Night & Innovation Showcase.
Fully compliant with all graphic standards.
Design elements are strategically placed using rule of thirds and strong emphasis.
Contains very few or no grammar or spelling errors.

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Contestant maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
The presentation content flows adequately, and the contestant demonstrates a clear and well-integrated structure throughout.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information.
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges’ questions.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Carry-in and set-up of equipment must be done solely by the contestant within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, contestants may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Finals may be part of the competition
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this judged event
Contestants must be registered for the national competition before the submission deadline and compete in both parts of the event to be ranked
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines or Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
